title: Maria's Town
text:
Maria lives in a small town. In the town center there is a big park. Next to the park, there is a library. Maria goes to the library every Saturday to read books.

Across the street from the library is a bakery. The bread there is very good. There is also a post office near the bakery. Maria buys bread and then sends letters at the post office.

questions.text: What is across the street from the library?
How does Maria probably feel about the library?
Where can Maria probably buy bread and mail a letter in one trip?
options: At the bakery and post office

a shop that sells bread and cakes

on the other side of a street or area

paragraph_translations: María vive en un pueblo pequeño. En el centro del pueblo hay un parque grande. Al lado del parque hay una biblioteca. María va a la biblioteca todos los sábados para leer libros.

Al otro lado de la calle de la biblioteca hay una panadería. El pan de allí es muy bueno. También hay una oficina de correos cerca de la panadería. María compra pan y luego envía cartas en la oficina de correos.
